remarks: Thank you for your interest , sellers are respectfully requesting highest and best offers by 3/22 @5pm . stunning 5-bedroom, 3.5-bath home offers beautifully updated living space on a level 1-acre lot at the end of a sought-after cul-de-sac, just minutes to top-rated schools, beaches, & the many amenities of Westport. Flooded w/ natural light from vaulted ceilings & skylights, the chef's kitchen features a Wolf range & an oversized island ideal for gathering and opens seamlessly to a comfortable living area w/ a fireplace & a wet bar. French doors lead to a TimberTech deck overlooking the private, level backyard, creating effortless indoor-outdoor living. Freshly finished hardwood floors run throughout the home, complementing the bright interiors. The dining room showcases a wall of windows. The family room includes built-in bookshelves/entertainment center, a second fireplace, half-bath and offers access to a bluestone patio, another inviting space to relax or entertain. The primary suite is exceptionally spacious w/ a vaulted ceiling, dual walk-in closets, and a luxurious bath, along with an adjacent bedroom w/ Belvedere balcony, currently used as an office, which could also function as a nursery. 3 additional well-appointed bedrooms, including one ensuite, provide comfort and privacy for family or guests. The basement includes a wine cellar & full-height unfinished space, offering exceptional storage & potential for future expansion. Freshly painted on the exterior
